subject: Post-call demo readout and team onramp
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@novaplay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + next demo slots

Hi Daniel —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: validate integration feasibility for customer-facing recommendations (real-time low-latency inference in your service).
- High‑level asks from your side: SSO/SAML, data residency questions, and an initial perf target of < 120ms p50 on 512-token windows.

Suggested next step: a 60‑minute technical deep dive + demo where we bring our infra lead and a security engineer.
Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Mar 2, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Mar 3, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Mar 4, 09:00–10:00

Please reply with preferred slot or share a calendar link and I'll lock it. I'm looping in Marissa (CS lead) to coordinate the specifics and Sean (solutions architect) to cover deployment patterns.

Attached: redwood_postcall_summary.pdf (summary + initial config questions)

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Park <dpark@novaplay.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next demo slots

Thanks Irene — good recap.

We can do Wed Mar 3, 14:00 PT. I'll confirm with Sasha (platform eng) and our procurement lead.

Couple quick notes:
- The 120ms p50 is ambitious but a useful target.
- We will need SOC2 evidence and a compliance contact before the demo.

I'll loop in Sasha and procurement in my follow-up.

Best,
Dan

Date: 2027-03-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next demo slots — introducing security & procurement

Hi Dan and Sasha —

Thanks for confirming Wed Mar 3, 14:00 PT. Quick update and introductions so procurement and security can be ready:

- Marissa Cole (CC) will handle the session logistics and send a calendar invite with a shared doc.
- Sean Gallagher (CC) will present deployment options and demo the low-latency path.
- Rishi Malhotra (CC) from our security team is included to answer SOC2/compliance questions live. Rishi — attaching a short SOC2 summary and our post-call notes.

Attachments:
- SOC2_Summary.pdf (one‑pager)
- redwood_postcall_summary.pdf (from earlier)
- demo-slot-options.ics (calendar stub)

Things we need from your side before Wed:
- Procurement contact and preferred PO/contract pathway (DocuSign? SOW?)
- Any must-have compliance controls beyond SOC2 (e.g., IRP, encryption key custody)

Marissa — can you please draft the invite for Wed and include the Google Drive folder (link below) for pre-read material?

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c

Thanks,
Irene
From: Sasha Lee <sasha.lee@novaplay.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <dpark@novaplay.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next demo slots — introducing security & procurement

Thanks — Wed works for me. Procurement lead is Priya Natarajan (priya.n@novaplay.com), copying.

We also want to confirm whether you can cover tokenization/hot-cache behavior for short bursts during the demo.

- Sasha
